newsitem.title: UK: Trinkaus & Burkhardt sets currency warrants.
newsitem.headline: Trinkaus & Burkhardt sets currency warrants.

text.p: Trinkaus & Burkhardt says it has issued 290 million American-style call and put warrants, in 29 equal tranches, on various currency pairs.

There are 20 tranches on the U.S. dollar/mark rate (10 calls and 10 puts), two tranches of calls on the lira/mark rate, six tranches on the U.S. dollar/yen rate (three calls and three puts) and one tranche of U.S. dollar/mark power warrants.
There are various maturity dates. The warrants will be listed on the Duesseldorf, Frankfurt and Stuttgart exchanges.
